title: Goldman Sachs CEO backs CLARITY Act, says it would advance crypto market
summary: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon supports the CLARITY Act, saying it would help guide the crypto market’s appropriate development by creating a fair competitive environment, CoinDesk reported. In an interview with Politico, Solomon said the bill was not perfect and remained open to debate, but would still support orderly market growth.CoinDesk said Solomon’s comments came as amendments to the CLARITY Act were submitted ahead of a U.S. Senate floor vote. The move contrasts with opposition to the bill from major banking executives including JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon, according to CoinDesk.The CLARITY Act is centered on clarifying the respective jurisdictions of the U.S. SEC and the CFTC in crypto regulation.
